Read the Tribunal PDFs this document links, which is where conclusions actually live; put the council's own accounts against DGAL's municipal-finance data, which the next section names as the missing source; and keep the daily snapshots, because the register erases its own history and a trend will exist where these observations accumulate. Until then the honest landing is the one this section has tried to give: not a verdict, but a map of where verdicts should be sought first (inference).
